name: workspace
description: A capability-secured processor architecture with an educational IDE, targeting the Tang Nano 20K FPGA. The Church Machine implements Golden Token (GT) security — every memory access is validated through unforgeable capability tokens, eliminating entire classes of vulnerabilities by construction.

scripts.test: node simulator/assembler_test.js && node simulator/test_saved_lump_cap_guard.js && node scripts/test_check_sidecar_source.js && node scripts/check-capabilities-blocks.js --glob '**/*.cloomc'
scripts.install-hooks: cp scripts/hooks/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit && echo 'pre-commit hook installed'
